cases.name: DMA read path should align expanded DRAM words and IB lanes with poisoned padding and exact logical bytes
DMA read path should traverse GEMM rows passes K tails and compact row cache using canonical addresses
DMA read path should keep W1 W2 cursors independent across explicit fusion phases and weight stride jumps
DMA read path should supply linear direct Quant Freq and NormSpill payloads with configured repeat boundaries
DMA read path should supply weight working sets once in local cache mode and repeat them in STREAM mode
DMA read path should commit real fill bytes before hits and preserve gaps partial pages and epochs
DMA read path should split hit miss and mapping boundaries without early chunk last or filling padding
DMA read path should reject invalid IB only data without a fabricated DRAM fallback
DMA read path should overlap independent full width returns and reserve a target through delayed fill commit
DMA read path should advance once at accepted dispatch and preserve a latched issue through long backend stalls
DMA read path should continue a partially issued tile across chunks and backend transfer limits
DMA read path should arbitrate conflicting IB read and fill commands on a shared backing port
DMA read path should merge dense compact and non power of two tiles without crossing a pass
DMA read path should fetch 65 expanded words for an unaligned 4KiB payload and fill only valid bytes
DMA read path should keep whole raw words and one logical last with a small maximum TL Get profile
DMA read path should preview five independent targets before permits and accept each winner only once
DMA read path should refresh a waiting source preview on commit while preserving epoch and IB only rules
DMA read path should use a fully published 512B tail page then DRAM for the nonresident range
DMA source scheduler should apply P0 P1 P2 and advance only on actual accepts with independent sources
DMA source scheduler should round robin equal priorities independently across all five targets
DMA source scheduler should promote an aged prefetch under continuous P0 and preserve age across source changes
DMA source scheduler should recheck full and enabled before reserving a held admission without blocking other targets
DMA scheduler integration should drain each source while the other stalls and accept two sources after independent admissions
DMA scheduler integration should allow IB during long DRAM stalls and DRAM during long IB stalls
DMA scheduler integration should reserve once and finish continuations despite full hungry and enable changes
DMA scheduler integration should keep tail full thresholds chunk exhaustion and simultaneous consume commit accounting exact
DMA scheduler integration should preserve buffered error bytes until confirmed discard and wait for every producer page
DMA scheduler integration should apply the 4096B free threshold even to tail requests and release only consumed occupancy
DMA scheduler integration should retain partially delivered error data until an identity matched discard commit
DMA scheduler integration should admit all five staged targets fairly without a source busy global head of line
DMA scheduler integration should drain a staged old consumer before releasing its page without a control hold deadlock
IB page publication and operation handoff should publish a 4096B page only after every unique lane despite duplicate small refills
IB page publication and operation handoff should compact every head offset and tail to page zero and replay only fully published payloads
IB page publication and operation handoff should hold the second derived write without duplicate OCM data or early publication
IB page publication and operation handoff should retain output as next input across A B swaps and reject unsafe or stale mutations
IB page publication and operation handoff should arbitrate output and DRAM fill commits and serialize shared IB read write conflicts
should allow an independent WB refill to unblock consumption while an unrelated page release waits
should not issue a second write into a page whose DRAM fill writer just closed
should serialize same-cycle page lease release against matching ingress while admitting unrelated ingress
should retain four 4KiB chunks independently in UB and WB using the integrated profile
should progress a destructive control after a FinishWriter stalls an unrelated unreserved admission
should keep destructive control fenced behind real reader and consumer lifetime
should reuse a spilled UB head across three complete passes and switch only after the stalled tail while preserving W1 W2
should commit a one-pass multi-segment row before reusing its pages and clamp the short final row
should map noncontiguous physical pages and leave VPU direct and local reused operands out of row population
should load a retained output as a local UB row with zero new population and zero DRAM requests
should roll a multipage unaligned GEMM head over noncontiguous pages and retire unused capacity in a short last row
should accept simultaneous configuration offers without cancellation or an idle cycle
should detect overflowing windows duplicate slots and overlapping live stream ownership
should share phase1 and phase2 offsets for NB only without virtual DRAM addressing
should share phase1 and phase2 offsets for NB plus IB tail without virtual DRAM addressing
should share phase1 and phase2 offsets for DRAM without IB without virtual DRAM addressing
should share phase1 and phase2 offsets for multi page IB plus DRAM without virtual DRAM addressing

should commit independent writers with exact lanes and stable bank backpressure conflict=true
